title: Record the margins of one rounded LU perturbation
body:
## Summary
- With the stated factor caps, the product perturbation stays strictly below `200 p^3 eta` and the perturbed inverse stays at most `64p`.
- The grown factor stays at most `66 p^2`, and amplifying the two residuals by that cap stays below `530 p^2 eta`, which is strictly below one.
- The comparisons hold for every positive precision and were checked directly for precisions 1 through 200. The selected κ is unchanged.

## Test plan
